description: Type the error deleteCertificatePack returns for a pack Cloudflare's certificate service will not delete — observed on a `status: "deleted"` tombstone (e.g. the advanced pack Cloudflare auto-orders for a Worker custom domain, after the domain is detached). It surfaces as a code-less HTTP 400 `Bad response certificate service` until Cloudflare purges the tombstone (~1–2 minutes).
